title: aspidium triangulum var. trapezoides
intro: Aspidium triangulum var. trapezoides, commonly known as the Indian fern, is a type of plant belonging to the family Aspleniaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of Indian fern are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include being a natural antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, helping to reduce fever and promote easy breathing. The bioactive constituents of Indian fern include various flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
